verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs list an API area that "Handles remote deposit capture (RDC) transactions," which is first-party support for the check-deposit half of the story. That support rests on a single thin line, and nothing in the evidence shows programmatic check issuance or outbound paper checks. missing for 10: programmatic check issuance/sending, documented image-capture details (front/back images, endorsement, holds/returns), in-depth RDC guide, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, checks still work — programmatic check issuance and check deposit with image capture, because real businesses still receive and send paper
